name: Hyperbolic Time Chamber - Endless Runner
summary:
Step into the legendary Hyperbolic Time Chamber and experience an intense VR fitness adventure. This anime-inspired endless runner is a cardio rhythm gameplay that will push your limits and forge you into a true warrior.

Journey through four breathtaking worlds, each crafted with stunning aesthetics that transport you straight into one of your favourite anime. The further you advance, the more intense it becomes – every environment becomes progressively more challenging as you prove your worth.
